title: Data Scientist
description: Company Description Beige Bananas is one of the world’s fastest-growing pure play AI consulting firms, specializing in hyper-custom AI products for rapidly evolving business use cases. Leveraging decreasing computation costs and increasing computational power, the company builds tailored AI solutions that align closely with client objectives. Beige Bananas maintains an outcome-driven mindset, helping organizations accelerate value realization from their analytics and AI investments. The firm serves Fortune 500 companies across Retail, CPG, and Media sectors, building long-term partnerships based on trust and measurable results. Role Description As a Data Scientist Intern at Beige Bananas, you will collaborate with senior data scientists and consultants to design, test, and refine data-driven solutions for client projects. On a day-to-day basis, you will clean and prepare datasets, conduct exploratory data analysis, build and evaluate statistical and machine learning models, and create clear visualizations and reports to communicate findings. You will contribute to proof-of-concept AI products, document methodologies, and support the translation of business questions into analytical approaches. This is a remote internship role, requiring proactive communication, reliable time management, and the ability to work effectively within distributed teams. Qualifications Strong foundation in Data Science and Statistics, with the ability to apply quantitative methods to real-world problems. Proficiency in Data Analytics and Data Analysis, including cleaning, transforming, and interpreting complex datasets. Experience with Data Visualization, using tools or libraries (e.g., Tableau, Power BI, Matplotlib, Seaborn) to present insights clearly. Hands-on skills in programming languages commonly used in data science (such as Python or R) and familiarity with SQL. Knowledge of basic machine learning concepts and frameworks (e.g., scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or similar) is beneficial. Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in a quantitative field such as Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or related discipline. Ability to communicate complex analytical findings in a clear, structured, and concise manner to technical and non-technical stakeholders. Comfort working in a remote environment, with strong organizational skills and a collaborative, outcome-focused mindset.

title: 2027 (6 Month) Internship - (Bengaluru) Software Engineering
description: Overview At Zebra, we are a community of innovators who come together to create new ways of working. United by curiosity and a culture of caring, we develop smart solutions that anticipate our customer’s and partner’s needs and solve their challenges. Being part of Zebra Nation means you are seen, heard, valued, and respected. Drawing from our unique perspectives, we collaborate to deliver on our purpose. Here you are part of a team pushing boundaries today to redefine the work of tomorrow for organizations, their employees, and those they serve. You’ll have opportunities to learn and lead in a forward-thinking environment, defining your path to a fulfilling career while channeling your skills toward causes you care about—locally and globally. Come make an impact every day at Zebra. What We're Looking For Our Data Science team provides Professional Services for our Enterprise SaaS Decision Management solutions that power multi-million-dollar supply chain operations. At the core of our platform is a foundational Time Series Demand Forecasting engine, which directly drives downstream optimization applications Our Data Science Team Provides Professional Services For Our Enterprise SaaS Decision Management Solutions That Power Multi-million-dollar Supply Chain Operations. At The Core Of Our Platform Is a Foundational Time Series Demand Forecasting Engine, Which Directly Drives Downstream Optimization Applications Including Inventory Allocation & Replenishment Assortment Planning & Store Clustering Initial Pricing, Promotions, and Markdown Optimization Predictive Ordering, and Size & Pack Optimization Intelligent Order Promising Retail Shrink, Fraud, & Supply Chain Anomaly Detection Workforce & Labor Scheduling Optimization The Frontier Of AI In Supply Chain To drive scalability and supercharge our analytical workflows, we are actively integrating Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), and Agentic AI capabilities into our services and our SaaS platform. From autonomous data discovery/mapping and natural language forecast validation and explainability to tackling complex "cold-start" demand scenarios (such as novel promotional strategies, new product introductions, or new store openings with zero historical data), we are bridging predictive mathematical rigor with generative reasoning. As a Data Science Intern, you will not be working on toy datasets. You will collaborate with senior data scientists and domain experts to explore messy enterprise data, benchmark state-of-the-art time series models, and prototype agentic workflows that redefine how retail decisions are made. 🎯 What You Will Do Develop & Benchmark Demand Forecasting Models: Research, build, and evaluate time series models ranging from tabular gradient boosters (e.g., XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) to modern deep neural networks and foundation models (e.g., TiDE, DenseNet, and TimesFM), and classical statistical baselines (e.g., Exponential Smoothing Methods and ARIMA) alongside Naïve Models. Conduct In-Depth Data Interrogation & EDA: Exercise your natural curiosity to deeply explore complex retail datasets, detect underlying patterns, identify anomalies, and perform root-cause analyses on unexpected demand shifts or model residuals. Power Downstream Decision Solutions: Connect demand signals into mathematical optimization algorithms and heuristic engines for allocation, pack optimization, price elasticity modeling, and workforce scheduling. Tackle Retail Anomaly & Shrink Detection: Build unsupervised and semi-supervised anomaly detection models to identify phantom inventory, shrink patterns, and supply chain bottlenecks. Work with Cloud Data Pipelines: Leverage modern data engineering frameworks on Databricks and Azure (utilizing PySpark, Delta Lake, Delta Live Tables, Unity Catalog, and SQL) to clean, aggregate, and prepare large-scale transactional POS and inventory data. Model Interpretability & Visual Storytelling: Implement explainability techniques (e.g., SHAP, feature importance) and design interactive visualization dashboards (Plotly, Streamlit) to translate complex analytical findings into clear business decisions. Explore GenAI & Agentic AI Workflows: Prototype agentic and LLM-assisted tools for automated data discovery, schema mapping, and ETL migration to scale and accelerate client onboarding. Experiment with LLMs for cold-start demand intelligence—leveraging analog matching, synthetic feature generation, and semantic understanding when historical sales signals do not exist. Build generative co-pilots that synthesize promotional halo/cannibalization effects and generate natural-language forecast validation & root-cause narratives. Minimum Qualifications 🔍 What We Are Looking For Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s, Master’s or Ph.D. (or senior-year undergraduate) in Data Science, Computer Science, Operations Research, Statistics, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related quantitative field. Strong Core Data Science & Math Foundation: Solid understanding of statistics, machine learning principles, and time series concepts (trend, seasonality, autocorrelation, stationarity, loss functions). Proficiency in Python & Core Libraries: Hands-on experience with pandas, numpy, and scikit-learn. Relational Databases & SQL: Solid command of SQL for data extraction, joining complex schemas, aggregation, window functions, and data cleansing. Data Curiosity & Problem-Solving Mindset: A tenacious desire to dig into the "why" behind data anomalies, model performance variances, and real-world supply chain behavior. Learning Agility: A fast learner with the motivation and drive to rapidly upskill and absorb new tools, cloud environments, and domain concepts. Preferred / Nice-to-Have (Not Required – Eagerness to Learn is Key): We do not expect day-one mastery across our entire stack. If you have strong foundational skills and an eagerness to learn, we will provide the mentorship and environment for you to master these tools quickly. Exposure to cloud and distributed platforms: Microsoft Azure, Databricks (PySpark, Delta Live Tables, Delta Sharing, Unity Catalog, MLflow). Experience with gradient boosting libraries (XGBoost, LightGBM, CatBoost) and deep learning frameworks (PyTorch or TensorFlow). Familiarity with or interest in modern time series architectures and foundation models (e.g., TiDE, DenseNet, TimesFM). Understanding of Operations Research & Mathematical Optimization (Linear/ Integer Programming with PuLP, SciPy.optimize, OR-Tools, or Gurobi). Familiarity with retail/CPG business metrics (e.g., sell-through rate, out-of-stock rates, price elasticity, GMROI). Interest or hands-on exposure to GenAI/LLM application development, prompt engineering, or agentic frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, CrewAI, Semantic Kernel, or OpenAI/Azure OpenAI APIs). 🚀 What You Will Gain End-to-End Ownership: Complete ownership of a high-impact capstone project solving a genuine enterprise retail supply chain challenge. Frontier AI & Enterprise Cloud Experience: Real-world experience combining cutting-edge GenAI/Agentic AI with enterprise Databricks/Azure lakehouses and time series foundation models. Direct Mentorship & Executive Exposure: 1-on-1 coaching from experienced Principal Data Scientists, culminating in an executive presentation of your findings to analytics and product leadership. Benefits We understand the importance of work-life balance and wellbeing, which is why we offer flexibility for our teams including: hybrid work, adaptable hours, Summer Flex Fridays, Focus Fridays, and an annual companywide well-being day to promote revitalization and success. Job Posting Statement To protect candidates from falling victim to online fraudulent activity involving fake job postings and employment offers, please be aware our recruiters will always connect with you via @zebra.com email accounts. Applications are only accepted through our applicant tracking system and only accept personal identifying information through that system. Our Talent Acquisition team will not ask for you to provide personal identifying information via e-mail or outside of the system. If you are a victim of identity theft contact your local police department. AI Technology Statement Zebra Technologies leverages AI technology to evaluate job applications using objective, job-relevant criteria. This approach enhances efficiency and promotes fairness in the hiring process. However, every decision regarding interviews and hiring is made by our dedicated team, because we believe people make the best decisions about people. For more on how we use technology in hiring and how we process applicant data, see our Zebra Privacy Policy.

title: Intern

Most packaging in India is used once and discarded, even when it can be reused multiple times. We work with brands to enable circularity for their packaging by building the systems, technology and supply chain required to collect, sort, sanitise and return packaging back into use. Our network currently includes housing societies, restaurants, hotels, cafés, collection partners and brands across Bengaluru. Today, REVERSE has: Enabled the reuse of 4.7M+ packaging units Worked with 15+ brands Built 355+ return points across Bengaluru and Goa Been supported by leading startup and innovation ecosystems, including IIM Bangalore and IIM Ahmedabad. We are now hiring interns across multiple functions to work closely with our team and help us scale packaging reuse. Open Internship Role: 1. Key responsibilities include: Support brand strategy, positioning and communication Plan and execute growth and behaviour-change campaigns Conduct customer and market research Interact with residents, businesses, brands and channel partners Support go-to-market plans for housing societies, cafés, restaurants and other channels Experiment with messaging, acquisition channels and engagement strategies Track campaign and customer conversion data Support partnerships and new market initiatives This role is ideal for someone interested in branding, marketing, consumer behaviour, strategy, growth and entrepreneurship. 2. title: Procurement Intern
description: Procurement Intern | Snabbit About Snabbit Snabbit is India’s first Quick-Service App delivering home services in just 10 minutes through a hyperlocal network of trained and verified professionals. Backed by Elevation Capital, Nexus Venture Partners, and Lightspeed, Snabbit is redefining the home services space by combining speed, quality, and trust. Founded by Aayush Agarwal, Snabbit aims to make home services as seamless and instant as ordering groceries. About the Role We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Procurement Intern to support the procurement team across data management, reporting, process documentation, and vendor coordination. You will work closely with the procurement team to maintain vendor databases, manage procurement MIS reports, support vendor onboarding, streamline documentation, and gain hands-on exposure to the Purchase Requisition (PR) to Purchase Order (PO) process. Key Responsibilities Maintain, clean, and regularly update the Vendor Master Database, item catalogs, and historical pricing logs. Ensure data accuracy across procurement spreadsheets and internal tools by removing duplicates and standardising entry formats. Collect, verify, and maintain vendor onboarding documents, including GST certificates, PAN, MSME status, bank details, and compliance forms. Assist in compiling, updating, and automating daily, weekly, and monthly procurement MIS reports. Track key procurement metrics such as PO turnaround time, open versus closed requisitions, vendor lead times, and cost-saving logs. Build basic dashboards and visual summaries using Excel/Google Sheets to monitor departmental spend and operational bottlenecks. Support the documentation of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for routine workflows, including PR-to-PO cycles and vendor onboarding. Help design and standardise internal request templates, approval checklists, and tracking sheets to streamline purchasing requests. Assist in identifying repetitive manual tasks and recommending simple workflow improvements. Support buyers in floating Requests for Quotations (RFQs) and preparing price comparison sheets. Follow up with vendors on order acknowledgments, delivery schedules, and invoice/GRN (Goods Receipt Note) discrepancies. Coordinate with internal stakeholders, including Finance, Warehouse/Operations, and requesting departments, to ensure smooth documentation flow. What We're Looking For Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Supply Chain Management, Business Administration, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of MS Excel / Google Sheets , including VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, IF statements, data cleaning, and basic charting.
